description: This file implements a NotificationService class for managing user notifications using a database client (supabase). It provides methods to create notifications, fetch user notifications, mark individual notifications as read, and mark all notifications as read for a user.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: A service class for handling notification-related operations such as creation, retrieval, and updating notification statuses.

methods.name: NotificationResponse create_notification(self, user_id: str, title: str, message: str, notification_type: str)
methods.description: Creates a new notification record in the database with specified details.

methods.name: List[NotificationResponse] get_user_notifications(self, user_id: str, unread_only: bool = False)
methods.description: Retrieves notifications for a specific user, optionally filtering for unread notifications.

methods.name: NotificationResponse mark_notification_as_read(self, notification_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read based on notification ID and user ID.

methods.name: bool mark_all_notifications_as_read(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Marks all notifications for a given user as read.
